brief.topic: A Diagonal Without a Diagonal Thread

s01: These diagonal bands are made from straight threads.
No thread travels along the diagonal.
The slant comes from how they take turns.
Keep the upright threads in place.
Pass a crossing thread over two, then under two.
For the next row, shift that same pattern one place.
Keep repeating the little sideways step.
A visible patch in one row moves one place across in the next.
Those patches line up along a diagonal.
The diagonal belongs to the pattern, not to a single thread.
After four rows, the crossing order returns.
There are four possible starting places in this over two, under two repeat.
With equally spaced rows and columns, one step up and one across makes a forty five degree band.
Spread the upright threads farther apart.
The crossing order stays the same, but the band becomes less steep.
This is one simple twill weave.
Sometimes a line we see is an agreement between many smaller gestures.

scenes.narration:
These diagonal bands are made from straight threads. No thread travels along the diagonal. The slant comes from how they take turns.

Keep the upright threads in place. Pass a crossing thread over two, then under two. For the next row, shift that same pattern one place. Keep repeating the little sideways step.

A visible patch in one row moves one place across in the next. Those patches line up along a diagonal. The diagonal belongs to the pattern, not to a single thread.

After four rows, the crossing order returns. There are four possible starting places in this over two, under two repeat. With equally spaced rows and columns, one step up and one across makes a forty five degree band.

Spread the upright threads farther apart. The crossing order stays the same, but the band becomes less steep. This is one simple twill weave. Sometimes a line we see is an agreement between many smaller gestures.
